summary.en: Iraq is coping with security gaps after the complete US troop withdrawal as Baghdad and Tehran activate joint security committees and discuss stronger ties. Iran-backed Iraqi militias have pledged to defend Iran if attacked, while Iraqi authorities are pursuing legal action against media incitement supporting pro-Iran armed groups and have arrested a lawyer who brandished a gun in court. The Shingal mayoral post, vacant for nine years, is now open for nominations, and Jordan's king reaffirmed support for regional sovereignty and security. The conflict recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
